title: orca.worker.lifecycle v1
description: Emitted by Orca's orchestration coordinator (src/main/runtime/orchestration/coordinator.ts) on every worker-dispatch state transition it observes: dispatched (preamble sent to a worker terminal), heartbeat (liveness ping recorded), completed/failed (worker_done settlement), and stale (heartbeat missed past the hung-dispatch threshold, warning only — the dispatch is not auto-failed). One event per transition, not a polling snapshot. Fire-and-forget via `nervous publish`; never blocks coordinator flow.

event_id.description: ULID identifying this lifecycle event (nervous-bus IDs convention).

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when this state transition was observed by the coordinator.

run_id.description: Coordinator run id (orchestration_db coordinator_runs.id) this worker belongs to.

worker_id.description: Terminal handle of the worker (assignee_handle / dispatch context assignee), or '<unknown>' if the dispatch context could not resolve one at stale-check time.

dispatch_id.description: dispatch_contexts.id for this worker's active dispatch. Null only for pre-dispatch-authority states.

task_id.description: orchestration task id this dispatch is executing. Null for heartbeat events, which carry only dispatch_id.

state.description: dispatched: preamble sent to the worker terminal. heartbeat: a heartbeat message was accepted and recorded. completed/failed: a worker_done report was settled with that outcome. stale: warnStaleDispatches flagged a missed heartbeat past the hung threshold (10 min); advisory only, the dispatch stays active.

task_title.description: Task title, or a truncated (200 char max, '…'-suffixed) excerpt of the task spec/prompt when no title was set. Truncated deliberately — task specs can carry secrets and this field must stay a short excerpt, never the full body.

outcome.description: Present only when state is completed/failed: the worker_done outcome as reported by the worker.
